title: A0 Quellfuge · Joint Applications + Box / Laschen
ownerAuthorization: Human Owner explicitly requested one package and authorized the bounded build on 2026-10-18.
goal: Reuse the existing Box / Laschen source and Joint Applications address profile as one inspectable Bench source seam with source-owned state, Stop, Witness and exact scoped Return.

milestones.title: Native Box / Laschen source contract
milestones.return: Exact scoped source Return for declared controls and selected integer/totient profile.

milestones.title: Joint address handoff
milestones.scope: Integer, prime exponents, totient and gap enter the existing typed Bench journal. For 1111 the declared Q4 address and explicit P0/F10, P1/F26 or P2/F42 witness can be selected and returned; other number profiles remain null/HOLD.

milestones.title: CON-DAO checkpoint / replay and browser acceptance
milestones.scope: The source owns the 14-tick cursor, displayed tick and timer state. Every native command first stops playback; CAPTURE and RETURN therefore certify the exact paused cursor/display state. Visible browser acceptance remains open.

milestones.title: Open live demo and guided movement test
milestones.scope: The Toy-Store-style demo is permanently open in the hero. Seven visible steps reuse the native source controls: open box, moving fold cycle, regular residual opening, exact contact plus Capture, CON-DAO motion, triangle/open-base contrast and exact Return. Starting the demo stops the competing global Master first; a floating tour dock keeps progress and Stop visible while the source surface moves.

acceptance: READ and CAPTURE originate in A0_TESSAREC_BLUE_BODY_LAB.html, not a parent recomputation.
SET validates all fields atomically and stops active fold/contact and CON-DAO playback before mutation.
RETURN restores and re-reads the exact declared source state.
CON-DAO CAPTURE stops its source timer and records the next cursor plus displayed tick; RETURN restores the exact paused state.
The open hero demo uses the same native source contract and players, exposes seven visible steps, stops the competing global Master, and keeps an immediate Stop visible in its floating tour dock.
The 1111 layer witness must be selected explicitly; missing maps for other number profiles remain null/HOLD fields.
No whole-machine, physical closure, carrier identity or scientific result is claimed.
stopConditions: A second fold/contact engine would be required.
A Q4 or layer address would have to be inferred without a declared map.
A running timer phase would be called exact even though native commands deliberately checkpoint only a stopped timer.
Canonical identity, Family, vocabulary, Study or claim-ceiling changes would be required.
